device: Jetson Orin Nano class 8GB; measured 7485 MiB system total
conclusion: Stock FP32-parameter CUDA loader has inadequate operational headroom with speech services. A memory-optimized FP16 deployment is only a candidate for an isolated peak-memory and latency test; not validated to fit.
limitations: No Laya CUDA model was loaded or timed on Jetson.
Offline ASR stress requests were additional to the live streaming ASR session; this overstates the normal single-stream sequential path and is not a matched end-to-end voice run.
Post-probe ASR allocations remained resident and swap increased; speech containers were not restarted or caches flushed.
GPU utilization percentage does not measure free GPU memory.
PyTorch/Transformers/Laya were absent from the inspected host Python3; existing speech containers had no python3 executable.
